title: Courier Circuit
goal: Paint a small route, move through it, dispatch a courier and keep a portable record of the delivery.
handoff: An original route document carries cell IDs, courier target, seed and semantic events into the navigation scene and replay viewer.
flow: Edit a bounded tile route and inspect collisions
Traverse with ordinary input and dispatch the courier
Compare the courier path with the player route
Select a viewer camera, export the route and replay its receipt sequence
acceptance: Edited cells affect actual collision/navigation
Courier arrival follows the allowed route
Player and scenario share operations
Document round-trip preserves semantic IDs
Replay resets and reproduces arrival within tolerance
failures: Blocked destination yields explicit unreachable result
Malformed route never replaces the good fixture
Exit/reset cancels dispatch and preserves ordinary seals

title: Clockwork Duel
goal: Play a readable timed duel against an original mechanical actor and compare its animation, impact and sound treatments.
handoff: Combat events identify attack windows, contacts and impact ticks; the rig, effects, camera and mixer subscribe to those same events.
flow: Choose original actor and stepped/smooth presentation
Move, guard and trigger attacks with ordinary controls
Inspect windup/contact/recovery, hit-stop and impact cues
Replay a bounded duel at alternate presentation rates without changing its outcome
acceptance: Hits occur only in declared contact windows
Animation blends/layers preserve the actor root contract
Hit-stop and mixer cues align with contact events
Viewer changes do not alter duel simulation
Reduced motion keeps combat state readable
failures: Missing clip/rig marker prevents activation visibly
Invalid attack during recovery is rejected
Reset during impact clears actors, effects and audio

title: Weather Postcard
goal: Grow an original island, shift its weather and light, and take a framed moving postcard with honest renderer comparisons.
handoff: A seed and scene recipe bind terrain, placement, atlas/vertex shade, world clock, weather and camera cues to one source-bound take.
flow: Select a bounded seed and paint the island palette
Grow terrain/props and explore their silhouettes
Move the clock, light and weather through comparison presets
Capture an independent viewer take and inspect pixels/metrics
acceptance: Seed reproduces declared terrain/placement
Weather/light changes are visible in temporal frames
Authored shading is distinguishable from live lighting
Renderer fallback identifies unavailable mechanisms
Camera take does not move the playable actor
failures: Oversized generation rejects before memory growth
Unsupported fog/shader path reports fallback
Cancelled take leaves prior postcard intact

title: Story Caravan
goal: Collect an original item, resolve a branching task, change language and resume the same story after restart.
handoff: Stable quest/item/dialogue IDs and versioned state survive localization, document export and a process restart.
flow: Navigate the caravan with keyboard/focus and comfortable text
Choose dialogue and inspect a quest transition
Craft/collect an item that fulfills the task
Change locale, save/export and resume after restart
acceptance: Only valid state transitions consume items
Dialogue/quest state survives real files and restart
Locale changes labels without changing semantic IDs
Focus recovery preserves the active action
Malformed imports preserve the existing story
failures: Unknown quest edge rejects visibly
Duplicate request cannot consume an item twice
Unsupported/newer schema does not reset user progress

title: Signal Orchestra
goal: Walk through acoustic spaces and conduct original timed music/voice cues while inspecting captured sound and captions.
handoff: One cue timeline links simulation events, audio buses, source positions, original speech fixtures and caption timestamps.
flow: Move near/far and left/right of audible sources
Switch acoustic and bus-routing presets
Conduct a bounded synchronized cue sequence
Capture and compare decoded sound/caption timing
acceptance: Encoded channels show expected positional changes
Bus effects have measurable differences without clipping
Music cues align within declared timing tolerance
Original speech captions match authored fixture timing
Mute and reset stop owned sound without losing progress
failures: Missing device/provider reports unavailable capture
Late cue is handled according to clock policy
Silent/corrupt recording fails the media gate

title: Two Worlds Together
goal: Play a shared delivery with two local processes, then inspect prediction, network loss and reconnection.
handoff: An explicit paired session owns authoritative entity IDs, ordered commands, replaceable samples and reconnection checkpoints.
flow: Start separate local host/client and pair explicitly
Move and deliver an object in the shared world
Inject bounded delay/loss and inspect prediction correction
Disconnect/reconnect and replay the authoritative result
acceptance: Real separate peers share authoritative state
Unauthorized clients cannot apply durable operations
Duplicate/late messages follow the declared policy
Reconnect converges within tolerance
Offline fixture is labeled as simulation
failures: Protocol mismatch rejects pairing
Packet storm is rate/budget bounded
Reset/session exit releases listeners and peer state

title: Maker to Movie
goal: Author an original rigged prop, play with it, direct it live while recording and compare a bounded revision sweep.
handoff: Recipe, imported attribute manifest, live operation receipts, simulation record and viewer track become one source-bound capture/evidence package.
flow: Run a bounded original Blender recipe and validate interchange
Explore the imported rig/clip/material in ordinary play
Use CLI/MCP/live controls in the same Cappy-recorded session
Produce event-anchored takes and compare approved parameter variants
acceptance: UV/color/rig/clip/unit markers survive declared round trip
One session serves live control and real Cappy capture
Operations and movie events align
Comparison binds exact source/fixture/look/profile
Cancelled worker preserves prior good output
failures: Missing attribute/license or corrupt asset rejects activation
Stale build evidence cannot qualify current source
Provider loss/worker capacity failure produces no success artifact

title: Device Expedition
goal: Carry a small original interaction across available exports and spatial/input adapters, seeing readiness and limits honestly.
handoff: A portable interaction fixture and operation record retain semantic IDs while each target owns its input/presentation adapter and evidence.
flow: Select a probed target/profile and inspect missing gates
Operate the fixture with available native/browser/spatial input
Compare input receipts and comfort modes
Export/test the available route and inspect deferred device gates
acceptance: Default desktop remains independently playable
Actual target build/export is tested separately
Unavailable adapter has a meaningful labeled fixture route
Input maps to equivalent semantic operations
Physical sensor/XR/comfort claims remain pending without devices
failures: Missing SDK/plugin/permission reports exact readiness reason
Unsupported native ABI is not loaded
Lifecycle interruption resets owned input/session state
